title: Counter and Hosting stay side-safe, direct and replayable
steps: Create a game with demo_runner_099 and demo_corp_099.
Runner installs Host Resource with a program in grip.
Runner receives a private hosting Choice; Corp payloads do not include candidate titles.
Runner resolves the Choice and the program receives a direct hostedOn relation.
Validation rejects self-hosting, missing-host and cycle states.
Corp trashes the tagged Runner host resource and hosted program is moved to heap with the host.
